description: Router, one in to one of eight out — selected by clock, by voltage, or both

params.text: How many outputs to cycle through
Knob and CV address an output directly, added to the clocked position. The CV runs -10V to +10V in steps of 1.25V

inputs.text: Knob and CV address an output directly, added to the clocked position. The CV runs -10V to +10V in steps of 1.25V
The signal routed to whichever output is selected

outputs.text: The input while that output is the selected one, and 0V the rest of the time

notes: with nothing patched to IN, the selected output carries 10V, which makes the module an eight-step gate sequencer
menu: Polyphony channels from — chooses which input sets the module's channel count, CLOCK input or SELECT input
Reverse step on negative clock — a clock pulse that goes below 0V steps backwards, which the FWD/REV switch then reverses again
Triggered select mode — the SELECT input takes triggers that advance a second sequence whose length the SELECT knob sets, instead of reading a voltage
Wrap select at steps — the select value wraps round at the STEPS setting rather than at the full number of steps
Select on clock mode — the SELECT knob and its CV are read only when a clock pulse arrives, rather than continuously
